name: What is involved in waterproofing a shower before tiling?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in waterproofing a shower before tiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Waterproofing a shower before tiling involves creating a barrier to prevent water from penetrating the walls and floor, protecting the structural integrity of your home from moisture damage and mold. This process typically includes installing a waterproof membrane over cement backer board on the shower walls and floor. Techniques can range from liquid-applied membranes to sheet membranes. Proper slopeto the drain is also essential for water runoff. This critical step ensures the longevity of your shower and the health of your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterproofing a shower involves applying a waterproof membrane over backer board on walls and floor to prevent water penetration. Proper slope to the drain is also critical.
